turns.q: Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
turns.replyTail:
AI Agent powered by
Cancel
Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter: You can get started with the cooler and regular ice—no special accessories are required. To get the best cooling performance: - Pre-chill the cooler with a bag of ice before packing your cold food and drinks. - Fill it with about two-thirds ice and one-third food or drinks. - Pack any remaining air space with ice or towels. YETI ICE® is optional and can be placed on the bottom of a pre-chilled cooler to help keep ice frozen longer.

Message from you:
How do I use it properly the very first time?
Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter:
For the first use of your Roadie® 15 Hard Cooler, these steps will help maximise its cooling performance: 
Cool down your cooler: Preload it a few hours before use with a sacrificial bag of ice, or store it in a cool place before loading it.
Cover the base with YETI® Ice Blocks: This helps extend the life of your regular ice.
Add ice: Place large ice cubes or blocks of ice on top of the base layer.
Pack in your provisions: Ideally, pre-chill your food and drinks before placing them inside.
Use a 2:1 ice-to-contents ratio: Use two parts ice to one part chilled food or drinks.
Fill leftover space: Use towels, rags, or more ice to reduce warm air pockets.
Limit opening the cooler: Keeping it closed helps the ice last longer.
Keep it covered: Ice lasts longer in the shade, so try to keep the cooler out of direct sunlight.
Leave melted ice inside: Cold water helps the remaining ice last longer, but keep exposed food and meat out of the water.
